descriptions.Music Therapy: Using music to address physical, emotional, cognitive, and social needs through listening, singing, or playing instruments.
descriptions.Cinema Therapy: Using films as a therapeutic tool to gain insight, process emotions, and stimulate discussion about personal challenges.
descriptions.Sand Therapy: A hands-on therapeutic approach using sand and miniature objects to create scenes that reflect one's inner world.
descriptions.Mandala Drawing Therapy: A calming art therapy technique using mandalas to reduce anxiety and bring focus and emotional balance.
descriptions.Drama Therapy: Using theater techniques and role-playing to explore emotional issues and foster personal growth.
descriptions.Dance Movement Therapy: Using movement and dance to support intellectual, emotional, and motor functions of the body.
descriptions.Collage Therapy: Creating collages from various materials to express feelings and thoughts that might be hard to verbalize.
descriptions.Photography Therapy: Using photography as a means of self-expression and exploration of personal identity and perspective.
descriptions.Clay Therapy: Working with clay to release emotions, reduce stress, and improve self-esteem through tactile creation.
descriptions.Poetry Therapy: Using reading, writing, and discussing poetry to promote healing and personal growth.
descriptions.Puppet Therapy: Using puppets to act out emotions and experiences, helping individuals express difficult feelings in a safe, symbolic way.
descriptions.Nature Art Therapy: Creating art with natural materials (leaves, twigs, stones) to foster grounding, mindfulness, and connection to the environment.
